title: Monthly Repayment Capacity of Disability Compensation Recipients — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Waiver Schedule
content:
In measuring what a debtor in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** can be expected to repay from their own means, the monthly repayment capacity of a debtor holding a running **Disability Compensation** award is a share of that award's monthly veteran-alone rate.

| Running Disability Compensation award | Monthly repayment capacity |
|---|---|
| Combined rating 60 percent or more, with a monthly veteran-alone rate on the award | 10 percent of the award's monthly veteran-alone rate (high-rating capacity percentage) |
| Combined rating 10 to 50 percent, with a monthly veteran-alone rate on the award | 5 percent of the award's monthly veteran-alone rate (mid-rating capacity percentage) |
| No running award | No capacity under this schedule |

The combined rating and the monthly veteran-alone rate are read from the debtor's running Disability Compensation award. The capacity figure is not rounded on its own; it is the monthly figure carried over the repayment horizon.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical awards)

- A 70 percent award paying a veteran-alone rate of 1,716.28 USD a month: capacity 10 percent of it, that is 171.628 USD a month.
- A 60 percent award at 1,395.93 USD a month: exactly 60 percent falls in the first row; capacity 139.593 USD.
- A 50 percent award at 1,102.04 USD a month: capacity 5 percent, that is 55.102 USD.
- A 10 percent award at 175.51 USD a month: capacity 8.7755 USD.
